comparison.objective: Load a press and operate a two-hand control safely, not configure a robot gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Blank placement, withdrawal from a hazard, and simultaneous button holding.
comparison.success_condition: Press closes on the blank while both controls are held after grippers clear the die.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous safety-control operation is meaningfully different from concentric screw-and-jam-nut adjustment.
